Stretching and mobility are crucial components of any exercise routine. Since we're focusing on bodyweight exercises, I recommend incorporating static stretches after each workout to help improve flexibility and reduce muscle soreness.

Some examples of stretches you can do:

* Hamstring stretch: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, then bend forward at the hips until you feel a stretch in the back of your legs.
* Chest stretch: Stand in a doorway with your hands on the doorframe at shoulder height, then lean forward until you feel a stretch in your chest.
* Quad stretch: Stand with one hand against a wall for balance, lift one leg behind you, and grab your ankle with your hand. Pull your heel towards your buttocks until you feel a stretch in the front of your leg.

Remember to hold each stretch for 15-30 seconds and breathe deeply to help relax your muscles. You can also incorporate dynamic stretching before your workouts, such as arm circles or leg swings, to get your blood flowing and warm up your muscles.
